title: Build an office PC
ticket: The office needs a PC for email and spreadsheets: nothing fancy, and no money for a graphics card. Build it from the parts on the bench so that it starts Windows with a picture on the screen. Not every part on the bench fits with every other: read the spec cards.

tasks.text: It starts Windows, with a picture on the screen.
tasks.hint: No graphics card: the CPU has to have its own graphics (a G model), and the monitor goes into the motherboard. Then follow the CPU to the board that matches its socket.

tasks.text: Both DDR4 sticks are in, running in dual channel (16 GB).
tasks.hint: Two sticks: one in each channel. On a two-slot board that's A1 and B1.
